context.description:
Model context carries only what the model cannot otherwise know; the Host
may show it to the user, so it never repeats the model's own request.

items.description:
One reviewed Creator row as a follow-up needs it: the saved Creator, or why
the row was not saved. Display fields stay on the card.

operation.description: The durable effect classification for one confirmed Creator row.

anyOf.description: A bounded, secret-free explanation for a row outcome.

summary.description: Counts for all rows represented by one Creator save completion.

oneOf.description:
The model prepared the scopes itself and the card cannot change them;
the user may have edited the acceptance criteria and keywords.

requires_model_context.description:
True exactly when the context carries content the model needs and the
concise message omits; only then is context sent, and the Host must
accept it before the message.

schema.description:
A transient diagnostic annotated by the runtime that actually ran the stage.
This is deliberately separate from durable receipts and effect state.

diagnostic.description:
Safe evidence from the actual protocol. Codes have meaning only within the
platform, protocol and origin that supplied them. Absence is not a diagnosis.
Human messages must be owner-authored constants, never raw provider Display.

origin.description: Where a diagnostic was established, not an effect or recovery classification.

schema.title: DmFailure

failure.description:
A bounded, secret-free terminal cause for a failed presented result.
Successful and non-failed states carry `null` so the model cannot
mistake an absent cause for an unreported failure.

completed_sections_count.description:
Exact completed prefix inside presentation.sections; the current review
follows it. This is display state and never grants execution authority.

locale.description: Display-only preference; excluded from result identity and user authority.

reason.description:
Safe explanation for a prepared row that is not directly selectable.
A safe explanation paired with a non-selectable prepared row.

intent.description:
The caller's explicit save policy.  The policy is held with the prepared
rows so confirmation cannot silently turn an "add only" request into an
update after the review has been shown.

anyOf.description:
Safe explanation for a prepared row that is not directly selectable.
A safe explanation paired with a non-selectable prepared row.

source_url.description: Public content evidence carried by the prepared selection, not authority.

status.description:
Owner-derived actionability for one prepared row.  Adapters may display
this value but must not infer it from identity or route fields.

summary.description: Mutually exclusive, owner-derived counts for one immutable preparation.

keywords.description:
Editable acceptance keywords. Changing these does not rewrite a selected
operation's arguments; changed provider criteria require a new plan.

items.description: One search the plan runs after the user confirms it.

arguments.description: Search criteria for the selected operation, valid under its input_schema. Omit search_plan_policy, confirmed_plan_ref and cursor; they belong to the later search call.

connection.description: The tagged connection returned by onecrew_connection_list for the operation's toolkit.

schema_revision.description: Copy verbatim from onecrew_tool_get for operation_id.
